scope: Soft rounded back-arrow treatment in both account headers; enhanced left navigation for Account Settings.
environment: Local development server with real components and a synthetic member; temporary review route removed before production build. No profile changes submitted.
browserChecks: Desktop navigation panel is 208px wide, beside the existing forms; no horizontal overflow.
Section links land below the sticky global header; desktop navigation remains at 88px from the viewport top.
Profile and Trust & safety anchor links select the matching aria-current location; keyboard PageDown changes the highlight to Profile.
Both themes inspected; neutral back-arrow fill and 10px corners verified on Account Settings and User Profile header contexts.
390px and 320px browser-frame layouts have no horizontal overflow and use static wrapped navigation; all section links are 44px high.
768px layout retains static navigation above the forms.

validation.eslint: Passed for the modified account components.
validation.existingTests: 12 passed: profile saving and header people search.

limitations: Responsive checks use real application content inside browser frames, not physical devices. Backend-only account panels require a genuine authenticated session.
